svg.title: Pandan Reservoir AI image incident and disclosure timeline
svg.desc: Chronological timeline of the August 20 crocodile-image report, August 21 fake-image confirmation and August 22 resumption of water activities, September 29 court charges, and PUB's October 1 public disclosure that earlier AI checks were inconclusive.
svg.text: Four dates. Three different kinds of evidence.
Timeline dates mark reported events or public disclosure, not detector runtime.
Inconclusive detection is not authenticity. Precaution is not proof. A charge is not a conviction.
